events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! LASK 0, Liverpool 1. Ronald Araujo (Liverpool) header from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Kostas Tsimikas with a cross following a corner.
Goal! LASK 0, Liverpool 2. Bradley Barcola (Liverpool) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Lewis Koumas.
Goal! LASK 0, Liverpool 3. Bradley Barcola (Liverpool) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Florian Wirtz.
Substitution, LASK. Florian Flecker replaces Kasper Jørgensen.
Second Half begins LASK 0, Liverpool 3.
Goal! LASK 0, Liverpool 4. Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Kostas Tsimikas with a cross.
Substitution, Liverpool. Virgil van Dijk replaces Jérémy Jacquet.
Substitution, Liverpool. Joe Gomez replaces Ronald Araujo.
Substitution, LASK. Robert Ljubicic replaces Melayro Bogarde.
Goal! LASK 1, Liverpool 4. Robert Ljubicic (LASK) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Yvan Dibango.
Goal! LASK 1, Liverpool 5. Bradley Barcola (Liverpool) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jeremie Frimpong.
Substitution, LASK. Sasa Kalajdzic replaces Samuel Adeniran.
Substitution, LASK. Daniel Elfadli replaces Alessandro Schöpf.
Goal! LASK 1, Liverpool 6. Lewis Koumas (Liverpool) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jeremie Frimpong with a cross.
Substitution, Liverpool. Víctor Muñoz replaces Bradley Barcola.
Goal! LASK 2, Liverpool 6. Florian Flecker (LASK) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Yvan Dibango.
Goal! LASK 3, Liverpool 6. Florian Flecker (LASK) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Yvan Dibango with a cross.
Daniel Elfadli (LASK) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, LASK. Nael Kane replaces Christoph Lang.
Substitution, Liverpool. Alexis Mac Allister replaces Trey Nyoni.
Substitution, Liverpool. Luke Chambers replaces Rio Ngumoha because of an injury.
